**no**; **`mysql.NewDB` is only invoked from the driver-selection factory** in `store/db/db.go:22` (`db.NewDBDriver`). A repo-wide search shows no other call sites for `mysql.NewDB`, and `github.com/usememos/memos/store/db/mysql` is imported only in `store/db/db.go`. All runtime and test entry points use the factory instead: `cmd/memos/main.go`, `store/test/store.go`, and `server/router/api/v1/test/memo_service_benchmark_test.go` all call `db.NewDBDriver(profile)`.

The only other direct `DB` construction is `&DB{}` in `store/db/mysql/auth_config_test.go:12`, used to unit-test `IsRetryableAuthenticationMutationError` without opening a database connection — not a full MySQL driver instantiation via `NewDB`. Test infrastructure in `store/test/containers.go` uses `sql.Open("mysql", dsn)` for container setup, which is the low-level `database/sql` driver, not the Memos `store/db/mysql` driver package.
